boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named, campus-adjacent destinations on the Woodland, Mount Royal, and Kenwood corridors.

cards.title: Mount Royal Market
cards.subtitle: Woodland Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Stop at 1600 Woodland Avenue for groceries; the market’s official listing identifies this Duluth location and daily store hours.
cards.short_summary: A named grocery destination on the Woodland Avenue approach to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Mount Royal Market lists its address as 1600 Woodland Avenue, Duluth, and states it is open daily from 6:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Retail grocery store; confirm current department availability before visiting.

cards.title: Mount Royal Branch Library
cards.subtitle: Mount Royal Shopping Circle off Woodland Avenue
cards.notes: Use the public branch at 105 Mount Royal Shopping Circle for a library stop beside the Woodland Avenue corridor.
cards.short_summary: A public-library destination in the Mount Royal retail cluster.
cards.evidence_claim: Duluth Public Library lists its Mount Royal location at 105 Mt. Royal Shopping Circle, Duluth.
cards.access_notes: Check the branch’s current location-hours page before heading over.

cards.title: Mount Royal Post Office
cards.subtitle: Mount Royal Shopping Circle off Woodland Avenue
cards.notes: Handle mail or PO Box errands at the Mount Royal station, 200 Mount Royal Shopping Circle, in the campus-adjacent retail node.
cards.short_summary: A named USPS station for practical errands near Mount Royal.
cards.evidence_claim: USPS lists the Mount Royal Post Office at 200 Mount Royal Shopping Circle in Duluth and identifies retail and PO Box services.
cards.access_notes: USPS lists retail hours Monday–Friday 8:30 a.m.–5 p.m. and Saturday 9 a.m.–12:30 p.m.; services vary.

cards.title: Bulldog Pizza & Grill
cards.subtitle: Mount Royal Shopping Circle off Woodland Avenue
cards.notes: Meet for a meal at the family restaurant at 101 Mount Royal Circle; its site identifies it as a neighborhood restaurant founded by a UMD alum.
cards.short_summary: A long-running pizza and grill destination in the Mount Royal cluster.
cards.evidence_claim: Bulldog Pizza & Grill lists 101 Mount Royal Circle, Duluth, and describes itself as a neighborhood family restaurant founded by UMD alum Ken Wright.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant lists hours Monday–Saturday, 11 a.m.–9 p.m.; confirm current service details before visiting.

cards.title: Duluth Yoga
cards.subtitle: Mount Royal upper lot off Woodland Avenue
cards.notes: Book a vinyasa class at Duluth Yoga, whose official page directs visitors to the Mount Royal upper lot for the studio.
cards.short_summary: A class-based movement stop in the Mount Royal area.
cards.evidence_claim: Duluth Yoga states that it offers vinyasa class options and directs visitors to the Mount Royal upper lot.
cards.access_notes: Create an account or use the Mindbody app to sign up, as directed by the studio.

cards.title: Hartley Nature Center
cards.subtitle: Woodland Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Visit the nature center at 3001 Woodland Avenue for park information, programs, and equipment-rental details before going outdoors.
cards.short_summary: An environmental-education destination on Woodland Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Hartley Nature Center says it is at 3001 Woodland Avenue and provides programs, equipment rental, park and trail information.
cards.source_title: Hartley Nature Center: Visit Hartley Park
cards.access_notes: Check the nature center’s current hours and program requirements; some programs or rentals may have fees.

cards.title: Hartley Park
cards.subtitle: Woodland Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use Hartley’s multi-use trails for a self-directed outdoor break; review the trail map and seasonal conditions before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A large Duluth city park reached from the Woodland corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Hartley Nature Center describes Hartley as a 660-acre Duluth city park with 10 miles of multi-use trails.
cards.source_title: Hartley Nature Center: Visit Hartley Park
cards.access_notes: The site provides trail maps and park updates; use them to select an appropriate route and conditions.

cards.entity_name: The College of St. Scholastica Duluth Main Campus
cards.title: The College of St. Scholastica
cards.subtitle: Kenwood Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Arrange a campus visit or attend a public-facing event at the neighboring college’s main campus at 1200 Kenwood Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A neighboring higher-education campus on the Kenwood route.
cards.evidence_claim: The College of St. Scholastica lists its Duluth Main Campus at 1200 Kenwood Avenue and offers campus visits.
cards.source_title: The College of St. Scholastica: Duluth Main Campus
cards.access_notes: Visitors must obtain a valid visitor parking permit; arrange visits through St. Scholastica.

cards.title: Duluth Kenwood Super One Foods
cards.subtitle: Arrowhead Road at Kenwood Avenue
cards.notes: Pick up groceries at 1316 West Arrowhead Road; the store lists deli, bakery, produce, natural-food, and seating services.
cards.short_summary: A full-service grocery stop on the Kenwood–Arrowhead corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Super One lists Duluth Kenwood Super One Foods at 1316 W. Arrowhead Road and identifies multiple grocery departments and services.
cards.source_title: Super One Foods: Duluth Kenwood store details
cards.access_notes: The store lists hours of 6 a.m.–10 p.m.; confirm current department hours before visiting.

cards.title: Walgreens on Kenwood
cards.subtitle: Kenwood Avenue at Arrowhead Road
cards.notes: Use the named Kenwood location for pharmacy, photo, or everyday retail needs at the Kenwood–Arrowhead junction near campus.
cards.short_summary: A retail and pharmacy destination at the Kenwood–Arrowhead intersection.
cards.evidence_claim: Walgreens lists a Duluth store and pharmacy at 1609 Kenwood Avenue, with pickup available.
cards.source_title: Walgreens pharmacies and stores near Duluth, Minnesota
cards.access_notes: Walgreens lists separate store and pharmacy closing times; verify current services and hours before visiting.
